physiological_mechanism: SLC5A2 (SGLT2) inhibition induces osmotic diuresis/natriuresis, reduces ventricular preload and afterload, and improves myocardial bioenergetics independent of glycemic status.
SGLT2 inhibition restores tubuloglomerular feedback, attenuating intraglomerular hyperfiltration, albuminuria, and renal tubular hypoxia.
SGLT2 inhibition reduces proximal tubular sodium-glucose reabsorption, lowering intraglomerular pressure and slowing diabetic nephropathy progression.
Tubulin polymerization inhibition suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome activation and IL-1beta/IL-6 neutrophil-mediated vascular inflammation.
Inhibition of microtubule assembly and NLRP3 inflammasome signaling stabilizes atherosclerotic plaques and attenuates macrophage-driven vascular inflammation.
Direct Factor Xa inhibition suppresses thrombin generation and PAR-1/PAR-2 mediated atherothrombosis when combined with low-dose aspirin.
High-purity EPA ethyl ester lowers triglycerides, reduces atherogenic ApoB particles, and exerts membrane-stabilizing and anti-inflammatory effects in coronary vasculature.
Non-competitive NMDA receptor antagonism triggers glutamate burst, AMPA receptor activation, and mTOR/BDNF-dependent rapid synaptogenesis in prefrontal cortex.
Uncompetitive NMDA receptor antagonism and sigma-1 receptor agonism modulate glutamatergic neurotransmission and rapidly restore synaptic plasticity.
Selective JAK1/JAK2 inhibition blocks Th2 cytokine signaling (IL-4, IL-13, IL-31, TSLP) driving cutaneous inflammation and pruritus.
JAK1/JAK2 inhibition interrupts IFN-gamma/CXCL10 signaling required for autoreactive CD8+ T-cell recruitment and melanocyte destruction.
Potent PDE4 inhibition elevates intracellular cAMP in keratinocytes and immune cells, suppressing IL-17, IL-23, and TNF-alpha inflammatory cascades.
Topical PDE4 inhibition raises intracellular cAMP, downregulating pro-inflammatory Th2 cytokines and restoring epidermal barrier homeostasis.
Targeted-release glucocorticoid acts on gut-associated lymphoid tissue (Peyer's patches) to suppress galactose-deficient IgA1 production upstream of glomerular deposition.

evidence_source: FDA Approved 2018 (Afinitor Disperz; EXIST-3 TSC seizures trial)
physiological_mechanism: Allosteric mTORC1 inhibition normalizes hyperactive PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling in tuberous sclerosis complex, reducing cortical epileptogenesis and seizure frequency.

evidence_source: Phase 2/3 Clinical Failure 2021 (RADAR RCT FAILED; Lancet Neurology)
physiological_mechanism: Hypothesized AT1R blockade to reduce cerebral hypoperfusion and amyloid pathology failed to slow brain atrophy or cognitive decline.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2022 (CCTG MA.32 RCT FAILED; JAMA)
physiological_mechanism: Hypothesized AMPK activation and insulin-lowering anti-proliferative effect failed to improve invasive disease-free survival in non-diabetic early breast cancer.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2024 (MAST / STAMPEDE Arm K FAILED)
physiological_mechanism: Hypothesized metabolic/mTOR inhibition failed to reduce progression in active surveillance (MAST) or overall survival in metastatic prostate cancer (STAMPEDE).

evidence_source: Phase 2/3 Clinical Failure 2023 (Scandinavian DSF-Cu Glioblastoma RCT FAILED)
physiological_mechanism: Hypothesized ALDH/NPL4-p97 proteasome inhibition with copper failed to improve survival in recurrent glioblastoma and increased toxicity.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2019 (CIRT RCT FAILED; NEJM)
physiological_mechanism: Low-dose antifolate anti-inflammatory therapy failed to lower IL-1beta, IL-6, or hsCRP levels and showed no reduction in cardiovascular events.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2022 (ALL-HEART RCT FAILED; Lancet)
physiological_mechanism: Xanthine oxidase inhibition and urate lowering failed to reduce myocardial infarction, stroke, or cardiovascular mortality in ischemic heart disease.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2020 (CKD-FIX / PERL RCTs FAILED; NEJM)
physiological_mechanism: Urate-lowering xanthine oxidase inhibition did not slow eGFR decline in patients with chronic kidney disease or type 1 diabetes.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2020 (STEADY-PD III RCT FAILED; Ann Intern Med)
physiological_mechanism: L-type Cav1.3 calcium channel blockade failed to slow clinical progression of early-stage Parkinson's disease.

evidence_source: Phase 2 Clinical Failure 2021 (NILO-PD RCT FAILED; JAMA Neurology)
physiological_mechanism: c-Abl tyrosine kinase inhibition showed poor CNS penetration and failed to improve motor outcomes or alpha-synuclein biomarkers in Parkinson's disease.

evidence_source: Phase 2 Clinical Failure 2022 (PD STAT RCT FAILED; JAMA Neurology)
physiological_mechanism: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition failed to demonstrate neuroprotective disease modification in moderate Parkinson's disease.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2018 (TOMMORROW RCT FAILED for futility)
physiological_mechanism: PPAR-gamma agonism failed to delay onset of mild cognitive impairment due to Alzheimer's disease in high-risk subjects.

evidence_source: Phase 3 Clinical Failure 2018 (HERO RCT FAILED; Ann Intern Med)
physiological_mechanism: Lysosomal/TLR immunomodulation failed to reduce hand pain or radiographic progression compared with placebo in symptomatic hand osteoarthritis.
